title: Iranian Parliamentary Delegation Presents Gift to Iraqi Speaker Mohammad al-Halbousi
text:
Iranian Parliamentary Delegation Presents Gift to Iraqi Speaker Mohammad al-Halbousi"

"**Baghdad, Iraq –** A high-ranking parliamentary delegation from the Islamic Republic of Iran, led by Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, presented a gift to Iraqi Parliament Speaker Mohammad al-Halbousi during an official visit to Baghdad."

"The Iranian delegation arrived in the Iraqi capital on Wednesday for a three-day visit aimed at discussing bilateral cooperation, border security, counter-terrorism efforts, and economic relations. Upon arrival at Baghdad International Airport, the delegation was received by First Deputy Speaker of the Iraqi Parliament Adnan Fayhan."

"Later, at the parliament headquarters, Speaker al-Halbousi officially welcomed Speaker Qalibaf and the accompanying delegation. During the meeting, the Iranian side presented a gift to the Iraqi speaker as a gesture of goodwill and friendship between the two nations."

"Speaking before departing Tehran, Qalibaf described the visit as particularly significant, emphasizing that relations between Baghdad and Tehran are "highly important and fundamental to regional developments". He noted that the two sides would discuss major issues concerning the development of economic, political, cultural, social and security relations between Iran and Iraq."

"Qalibaf also highlighted what he described as the effective roles played by both countries in regional affairs, stating that the visit could help lay the groundwork for taking advantage of new opportunities facing the two nations."

"The visit comes as part of ongoing efforts to strengthen parliamentary and diplomatic ties between the Islamic Republic of Iran and the Republic of Iraq.
